skillPoints.notes: 1 skill point per character level from levels 2-50. Capped at 49 from leveling alone. Additional points from renown (up to 10) and paragon boards are not tracked here.

paragonPoints.notes: 4 paragon points per paragon level. Paragon progression begins after reaching character level 60. Maximum paragon level is 300 (1200 points from leveling). Additional points from renown are not tracked here.

_sources.maxItemPower: no direct globals.glo.json entry; inferred from formula table ceiling constant in tools/datamine-import/formulas/index.ts (MAX_ITEM_POWER = 1000). Re-verify by checking the highest nMinItemPower ceiling in a representative formula's arAffixScalings on each patch update.

baseApsByWeaponType._notes: Base attacks-per-second per weapon type, hand-curated from in-game tooltips (Season 13). Source: see docs/aps-audit.md

innateSpeedByWeaponType._notes: Innate speed modifier per weapon type, hand-curated from arInnateStatList in ItemType/<WeaponType>.itt.json. Source: see docs/aps-audit.md
